title: Job posting
description: One posting in data/jobs/jobs.json, the same shape for every source. Filled by code from the actor's fields; text fields are untrusted. The safety check (stage 2c) adds `safety`; stage 2d adds `filter` (rule filter), `extracted` (facts read out of the text) and `match` (score against the profile); stage 3b adds `documents` (the CV and cover letter); stage 4 adds `application` once the candidate has applied; stage 5 adds `tracking` (replies to the application, read from Gmail).

id.description: Unique key '<site>:<source_id>' (site from config/apify_actors.json); a posting already in the file is never written again

data_source.description: Name of the actor in config/apify_actors.json the posting came from, e.g. APIFY_LINKEDIN_SCRAPER

source_id.description: The posting's id at the source

url.description: The posting's page at the source

company_url.description: The company's page at the source

employment_type.description: As the source writes it, e.g. 'Full-time'

seniority.description: As the source writes it, e.g. 'Mid-Senior level'

posted_at.description: Publication date as the source gives it

search_id.description: The query in data/searches/searches.json that found it first

raw_file.description: Raw source file it came from, relative to data/

created_at.description: When it was added to jobs.json

safety.description: Stage 2c safety check (src/jobfinder/safety.py); absent until checked. Stage 2d never reads a 'block' posting.

reasons.description: Reason codes, plus a domain for link checks, e.g. 'fee_request', 'apply_domain_unknown:example.xyz'

model_score.description: Prompt injection probability from the local classifier (jobfinder.guard); null when checked without it

filter.description: Stage 2d rule filter (src/jobfinder/score/rules.py), from the candidate's preferences; absent until filtered. Reason values are the candidate's own words or fixed codes, never posting text.

extracted.description: Stage 2d structured extraction: facts an LLM read out of the posting text. Written by an LLM that read untrusted text, so every value is capped; checked against this schema before it is stored.

required_languages.description: Spoken languages the posting requires, in English, e.g. 'German'

visa_sponsorship.description: null when the posting does not say

match.description: Stage 2d deep matching: how well the posting fits the profile, scored by an LLM against the rubric. Capped like `extracted`.

documents.description: Stage 3b: the CV and cover letter made for this posting by `jobfinder cv save`, which also moves the status from approved to cv_ready, with the cover letter as text and the posting as a PDF (both optional: older records lack them). Paths are relative to data/.

cover_letter_text.description: The cover letter as plain text, to paste into a form, e.g. cv/24-10-2026/acme-software-gmbh-4012345678/Ayse-Yilmaz-Cover-Letter.txt

job_description.description: The posting as stored, as a PDF to read, e.g. cv/24-10-2026/acme-software-gmbh-4012345678/Job-Description.pdf

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the documents, e.g. 'en'

model.description: The model the cv-writer agent ran on

reviewed.description: true when the documents are the cv-reviewer agent's revision (stage 3b review, optional)

application.description: Stage 4: written by `jobfinder apply mark` when the candidate says they sent the application, or by `jobfinder apply step` when the job-sender agent submitted it (status cv_ready -> applied)

applied_at.description: When it was sent (UTC); 00:00 of that day when the candidate gave only the day

via.description: `job-sender` when the agent of /apply submitted it; absent when the candidate applied by hand or the mail showed it

confirmed.description: job-sender only: whether the candidate approved the summary before it was submitted

interview_round.description: Status interview only: the round the candidate is in, set by hand (`jobfinder track interview`, the web UI)

closed_at.description: When `jobfinder track close` marked the application no_response (no mail for 60 days or more)

tracking.description: Stage 5: replies to the application found in Gmail by the mail-reader agent (src/jobfinder/track.py). Mail text is never stored; the note is written by an LLM from untrusted mail, so it is capped.

checked_at.description: When the last Gmail search that covered this posting started

outcome.description: The kind of the latest reply that answers the application; null while there is none

message_id.description: The Gmail message id; the same message is stored once

kind.description: received: the application arrived; other: about the application but none of the rest

note.description: What the message says, in English, e.g. 'Invites to a 30-minute phone screen'
